types.name: PairingCore.edge_exact_image
types.printed_type:
PairingCore.edge_exact_image : ∀ (K : PairingCore.Schedule) (u v : ℕ),
  PairingCore.Edge K u v ↔ ∃ g h, PairingCore.Genome g h ∧ PairingCore.owner K g = u ∧ PairingCore.owner K h = v

types.name: PairingCore.owner_exactly_two
types.printed_type:
PairingCore.owner_exactly_two : ∀ (K : PairingCore.Schedule) (v : ℕ),
  ∃ a b, a ≠ b ∧ ∀ (g : ℕ), PairingCore.owner K g = v ↔ g = a ∨ g = b

types.name: PairingCore.arbitrary_prefix_opposite_iap
types.printed_type:
PairingCore.arbitrary_prefix_opposite_iap : ∀ (N : ℕ),
  ∃ S,
    (∀ (g : ℕ), g / 8 ≤ N → PairingCore.owner (PairingCore.splitting S) g = PairingCore.owner PairingCore.mixing g) ∧
      SpeciesBridge.IAP (PairingCore.Edge PairingCore.mixing) SpeciesBridge.Whole ∧
        ¬SpeciesBridge.IAP (PairingCore.Edge (PairingCore.splitting S)) SpeciesBridge.Whole

types.name: PairingCore.constrained_counterexample
types.printed_type:
PairingCore.constrained_counterexample : ∀ (N : ℕ),
  ∃ S,
    2 ≤ S ∧
      S % 2 = 0 ∧
        (∀ (g : ℕ),
            g / 8 ≤ N → PairingCore.owner (PairingCore.splitting S) g = PairingCore.owner PairingCore.mixing g) ∧
          SpeciesBridge.WeaklyConnected (PairingCore.Edge PairingCore.mixing) SpeciesBridge.Whole ∧
            SpeciesBridge.WeaklyConnected (PairingCore.Edge (PairingCore.splitting S)) SpeciesBridge.Whole ∧
              PairingCore.TwoParents (PairingCore.Edge PairingCore.mixing) ∧
                PairingCore.TwoParents (PairingCore.Edge (PairingCore.splitting S)) ∧
                  PairingCore.TwoChildren (PairingCore.Edge PairingCore.mixing) ∧
                    PairingCore.TwoChildren (PairingCore.Edge (PairingCore.splitting S)) ∧
                      SpeciesBridge.MaximalSpecieslike (PairingCore.Edge PairingCore.mixing) SpeciesBridge.Whole ∧
                        ¬SpeciesBridge.Specieslike (PairingCore.Edge (PairingCore.splitting S)) SpeciesBridge.Whole ∧
                          SpeciesGlobalIAP.Inspecies (PairingCore.Edge PairingCore.mixing) SpeciesBridge.Whole ∧
                            ¬SpeciesGlobalIAP.Inspecies (PairingCore.Edge (PairingCore.splitting S))
                                  SpeciesBridge.Whole ∧
                              SpeciesBridge.IAP (PairingCore.Edge PairingCore.mixing) SpeciesBridge.Whole ∧
                                ¬SpeciesBridge.IAP (PairingCore.Edge (PairingCore.splitting S)) SpeciesBridge.Whole
